text: Provoleta is an Argentine provolone-type spun-curd cheese sold in small thick discs; the spun curd is dense enough to hold its shape when grilled whole at an asado.

steps.note: The cheese is shaped into discs 10–15 cm across and 1–1.5 cm thick.
